title: Unveiling Transcriptional Dynamics Across Five Developmental Stages of the Edible Mushroom Oudemansiella raphanipes.
authors: Ma, Yanjun; Yu, Lanlan; Zhang, Jinming; Dang, Yongxiang; Zhu, Xuetai
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA-seq分析食用菌发育阶段的转录组动态，仅提及转录因子MADS-box/bZIP作为差异表达基因，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Oudemansiella raphanipes is a prized edible mushroom renowned for its "three-high, one-low" nutritional profile (high protein, fiber, vitamins; low fat). However, the stage-specific molecular dynamics governing its development and their potential link to its superior nutrition remain unknown, hindering targeted genetic improvement. This study aimed to decipher the first comprehensive transcriptomic atlas across its five key developmental stages and to explore potential molecular signatures linked to its distinctive nutrition. We first confirmed the superior nutritional profile of O. raphanipes via comparative analysis with nine commercial mushrooms. RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) was performed on samples from five defined developmental stages (spores, mycelia, primordia, closed-cap and open-cap fruiting bodies), followed by de novo transcriptome assembly, functional annotation, and differential expression analysis. Results revealed extensive transcriptional reprogramming, with the most dramatic changes occurring at the spore-to-mycelium transition (19,827 differentially expressed genes). Stage-specific pathway enrichment highlighted regulators of germination (e.g., ribosome, transmembrane transport), primordium formation (e.g., glycerophospholipid metabolism, GTPase signaling), fruiting body development (e.g., starch/sucrose metabolism, terpenoid synthesis), and maturation (e.g., glycolysis, fatty acid biosynthesis, transcription factors MADS-box/bZIP). We identified 588 stage-exclusive genes in spores and 515 constitutively upregulated genes linked to energy metabolism and proteostasis. Crucially, integrating nutritional phenotypes with stage-resolved transcriptomics revealed that sustained transcriptional programs in mature fruiting bodies are associated with its nutritional excellence; e.g., upregulation of ribosomal/amino acid metabolic pathways aligns with high protein content, while active fatty acid degradation correlates with low fat levels. Our study provides the first multi-stage transcriptomic blueprint for O. raphanipes development, revealing stage-specific regulators and proposing molecular associations for its nutritional traits. This resource offers a foundational basis and candidate genetic targets for future breeding strategies aimed at enhancing agronomic and nutritional traits in this prized fungus.
abstract_zh: Oudemansiella raphanipes 是一种珍贵的食用菌，以其“三高一低”的营养特性（高蛋白、高纤维、高维生素、低脂肪）而闻名。然而，调控其发育的阶段特异性分子动态及其与其优良营养特性之间的潜在联系仍属未知，这阻碍了靶向遗传改良。本研究旨在解析其五个关键发育阶段的首个全面转录组图谱，并探索与其独特营养特性相关的潜在分子特征。我们首先通过与九种商业蘑菇的比较分析，确认了 O. raphanipes 的优良营养特性。对五个明确发育阶段（孢子、菌丝体、原基、闭盖和开盖子实体）的样本进行了 RNA 测序（RNA-seq），随后进行了从头转录组组装、功能注释和差异表达分析。结果揭示了广泛的转录重编程，其中孢子到菌丝体的转变阶段变化最为剧烈（19,827 个差异表达基因）。阶段特异性通路富集突出了萌发（如核糖体、跨膜转运）、原基形成（如甘油磷脂代谢、GTPase 信号传导）、子实体发育（如淀粉/蔗糖代谢、萜类合成）和成熟（如糖酵解、脂肪酸生物合成、转录因子 MADS-box/bZIP）的调控因子。我们在孢子中鉴定出 588 个阶段专属基因，以及 515 个与能量代谢和蛋白质稳态相关的组成性上调基因。关键的是，将营养表型与阶段解析转录组学整合分析揭示，成熟子实体中持续存在的转录程序与其营养优良性相关；例如，核糖体/氨基酸代谢通路的上调与高蛋白含量一致，而活跃的脂肪酸降解与低脂肪水平相关。我们的研究提供了 O. raphanipes 发育的首个多阶段转录组蓝图，揭示了阶段特异性调控因子，并提出了其营养性状的分子关联。该资源为未来旨在提升这一珍贵真菌农艺和营养性状的育种策略提供了基础依据和候选遗传靶点。
